name: gemini-batch-result-forwarder
title: Gemini Batch Result Forwarder
description: Fetches completed Gemini batch output and forwards it to the Gemini Batch Webhook Consumer actor.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API Key
gemini_api_key.description: Google Gemini API key used only to fetch the completed batch output.

gemini_batch_job_name.title: Gemini Batch Job Name
gemini_batch_job_name.description: Batch job name, usually in the form batches/....

consumer_actor_id.title: Consumer Actor ID
consumer_actor_id.description: Apify actor ID of the Gemini Batch Webhook Consumer actor.

supabase_service_role_key.title: Supabase Service Role Key
supabase_service_role_key.description: Service role key from Supabase -> Settings -> API

boards.title: Job Boards
boards.description: Which boards to trigger (linkedin, dice, indeed, monster, careerbuilder)

max_results.title: Max Results Per Search
max_results.description: Maximum jobs to fetch per board per role+location combination

posted_within.title: Posted Within
posted_within.description: Posting freshness mapped into each board payload

max_combinations.title: Max Role-Location Combinations
max_combinations.description: Cap on combinations consumed from Gemini payload

max_concurrent.title: Max Concurrent Board Calls
max_concurrent.description: Concurrency limit for triggering Supabase board functions

batch_max_wait_minutes.title: Batch Max Wait (minutes)
batch_max_wait_minutes.description: Maximum minutes to wait for Gemini batch completion before exiting.

batch_poll_interval_seconds.title: Batch Poll Interval (seconds)
batch_poll_interval_seconds.description: How often to poll Gemini batch status while waiting.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If true, parse payload but do not trigger board functions
